info.name: Select Star Metadata bi tags API

params.name: datasources
params.description: A comma separated list of data source guids to filter for items within those data sources. Works for dbt tags

params.name: items
params.description: A comma separated list of item guids to filter for their tags.

params.name: only_visible
params.description: An optional boolean filter to show visible items. If only_visible is set to `false`, then all tags (including hidden tags) are returned, otherwise only visible tags are returned.

params.name: owners
params.description: A comma separated list of user guids to filter for tag owners

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: parents
params.description: A comma separated list of tag parent guids to filter for

params.name: top_level
params.description: Filter tags to only return top level tags (tags without a parent). For example, 'top_level=true'. If top_level is set to `false`, then all tags are returned. Defaults to `false`.

params.name: types
params.description: A comma separated list of tag types to filter. Supported types: ['status']

params.name: updated_on
params.description:
Filter objects by updated_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/updated_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&updated_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects updated_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.
